questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Do everything in the mountains, skiing, hiking, climbing, canyoning, the opertunities in Innsbruck is world class, (join WhatsApp groups to find people to go with if you don’t all ready have network for it)

questions.answer: Mountains, as early as possible 5am/ 6am Train and bus and go wild with the sports listed above, and see South Tirol (Italy)

questions.answer: Relatively okay

questions.answer: Keep pushing for it and do activities together

questions.answer: Hierarchy is quite different from Denmark

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Openness, food and sport my attitude

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Be in good physical shape, get your German speaking level at a HIGH level, and go do more adventures whenever possible

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Housing is brutally hard, sign up for literally everything, then you can always say no if first offer comes in with plenty of time to spare in a less favourable location
